description: Historical resolved bugs for duplicate detection via TF-IDF similarity

bugs.title: Checkout 500 error after Stripe webhook config change
bugs.description: Payment checkout page returned 500 Internal Server Error after Stripe webhook secret was rotated. payment_intent_id was undefined because the env var STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET was not updated in production.
bugs.root_cause: Configuration error: Stripe webhook secret env var not updated after rotation. STRIPE_PAYMENT_INTENT was resolving to undefined.
bugs.resolution: Updated STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in production environment variables. Added validation in payment service to fail fast if Stripe env vars are missing.

bugs.title: SSO SAML certificate mismatch after identity service deploy
bugs.description: Enterprise SSO login failed for all SAML tenants after identity service deployment. Certificate fingerprint mismatch error in logs. All SAML 2.0 enterprise customers unable to authenticate.
bugs.root_cause: Deploy overrode the SAML signing certificate path with a default test certificate. Prod certificate not persisted in deployment config.
bugs.resolution: Rolled back identity-service to previous version. Added certificate validation step to deployment checklist and CI pipeline.

bugs.title: Reports API memory leak causing OOM crashes in production
bugs.description: Reports API endpoints returned 503 due to pods being OOM killed. Memory climbed continuously when processing large CSV exports. Memory never released after streaming response completed.
bugs.root_cause: StreamWriter not properly closed in the streaming response handler. Large dataset buffered in memory indefinitely. Introduced in streaming PR.
bugs.resolution: Fixed StreamWriter disposal using 'using' pattern. Added memory limits and circuit breaker for large exports. Pods stabilized after fix deploy.

bugs.title: Stored XSS in user bio field via rich text editor
bugs.description: Rich text editor on user bio allowed HTML injection. Script tags rendered unescaped on profile pages and activity feed. Stored XSS affecting all visitors to malicious profiles.
bugs.root_cause: HTML escaping removed from profile bio render template when rich text was enabled. Sanitizer applied on input only, not on render.
bugs.resolution: Disabled rich text on bio field. Re-added h() escaping on all user-controlled fields. Security audit of all templates completed. Sessions invalidated.

bugs.title: Theme toggle reloads page and clears form state
bugs.description: Dark/light mode toggle triggered full page reload instead of CSS context update. Any unsaved form data lost on toggle. Caused by legacy window.location.reload() call.
bugs.root_cause: Theme toggle implementation used window.location.reload() instead of React context update. Inherited from legacy codebase during migration.
bugs.resolution: Replaced window.location.reload() with ThemeContext provider update. Theme persisted to localStorage. No page reload required.

bugs.title: Login infinite redirect loop with OAuth Google SSO
bugs.description: Users logging in with Google OAuth entered infinite redirect loop. Browser showed ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS. Affected subset of users with accounts created before 2025.
bugs.root_cause: OAuth callback URL had trailing slash mismatch with registered redirect URI. New auth middleware added strict URL matching.
bugs.resolution: Normalized OAuth redirect URIs to strip trailing slash. Added URL normalization to auth middleware.

bugs.title: Database connection pool exhausted under high load — 500 errors on all endpoints
bugs.description: All API endpoints returned 500 after database connection pool was exhausted during peak traffic. Connections were not being released after queries completed. Service unavailable for 45 minutes.
bugs.root_cause: Connection pool leak in ORM query wrapper. Connections held open when exceptions thrown during query execution.
bugs.resolution: Fixed connection release in exception handling path. Increased pool size as temporary mitigation. Added connection pool monitoring alert.

bugs.title: Duplicate charges on retry — idempotency key not sent to Stripe
bugs.description: Users charged multiple times when payment retry was triggered due to network timeout. Idempotency key missing from Stripe API call allowing duplicate charge creation.
bugs.root_cause: Refactor of payment service removed idempotency_key parameter from Stripe API call. Code review missed it.
bugs.resolution: Restored idempotency_key generation using order_id + attempt_number. Refunded all duplicate charges. Added integration test for idempotency.

bugs.title: File upload silently fails for files over 10MB — no error shown to user
bugs.description: Files larger than 10MB fail to upload but the UI shows a success message. Files not saved to storage. Users think their files are uploaded but they are lost.
bugs.root_cause: Nginx proxy body size limit set to 10MB. Upload API returned 413 but frontend treated non-200 and 413 the same and showed generic success.
bugs.resolution: Increased Nginx limit to 100MB. Fixed frontend error handling to check for 413 and show appropriate message.

bugs.title: Notification emails sent to wrong users after bulk user import
bugs.description: After running bulk user import, welcome emails were sent to incorrect email addresses. Cross-contamination of user records in the import batch processing.
bugs.root_cause: Race condition in bulk import batch processor. Shared mutable state in email template renderer caused email addresses to bleed between concurrent import jobs.
bugs.resolution: Made email renderer stateless. Added per-job context isolation. Sent corrective emails to affected users.
